Description: COMPUTLESS AWS Lambda workload runner and a dispatcher role that can only invoke it.

ReservedConcurrency.Description: Cap on concurrent runs. 0 = no reservation (new accounts with a 10-concurrency quota cannot reserve any).

DispatcherTrustedPrincipal.Description: ARN allowed to assume the dispatcher role (e.g. the COMPUTLESS server role). Empty = IAM principals in this account that are granted sts:AssumeRole on it.

CreateBootstrapUser.Description: Create an IAM user whose only permission is assuming the dispatcher role (for a COMPUTLESS server outside AWS). Create its access key yourself; it is never put in stack outputs.

Properties.Description: COMPUTLESS runner: may only write its own logs.
COMPUTLESS workload runner (fresh V8 context per run, no string code generation).
COMPUTLESS dispatcher: may only invoke the runner function.

BootstrapUserName.Description: Create one access key for this user (IAM console) and store it in the server secret store
